description: Explains a seller's settled P&L for a period: revenue, fees, COGS and margin overall and per channel, unpaid (unsettled) orders/returns, unmapped SKUs, SKUs with no cost price, why a channel shows zero fees, and the worst-margin SKUs. Covers Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, Snapdeal, JioMart, Shopify, offline; settled orders only.

channel.description: Limit to one channel. Default: all connected channels.

search.description: Optional SKU / product-name substring to narrow to one product.

since.description: Start date (ISO, e.g. 2026-10-01, IST day). Default: 30 days ago.

until.description: End date (ISO, inclusive IST day). Default: today.

name: diagnose_pnl
title: Diagnose P&L
